decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans PL-002, PL-003, PL-004 
submitted 03 August 2011and EX-001, EX-002, EX-003, EX-004 submitted 10 June 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The two bathroom windows formed in the side dormer shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of front, side and rear roof extensions to the house, roof lights and alterations to ground floor openings to the house.
